data.narrative:
MBRYONICS is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €17.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on two applicable methodologies triangulated against a peer universe of 4 private companies at Series B/C stage (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, Skyryse) and 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Stage-progression methodology applies a 1.9x multiplier to the €17.5M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $33M. The peer-median approach anchors to a $1.6B median across the four selected private comparables, with a range spanning $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring is not applicable due to absence of revenue disclosure typical of early-stage private companies, despite a 27.4x median P/S multiple observed across the public peer set.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $28M to $1.9B, with a median of $842M. The wide spread reflects meaningful dispersion in peer outcomes at this stage. Key uncertainties include the magnitude and timing of MBRYONICS' revenue ramp, its competitive positioning relative to more mature Series C peers, and sector-specific capital intensity. The low-end estimate rests on capital-raised multiples; the high-end reflects upper-quartile peer valuations but should be weighted cautiously given stage and scale differentials.
